rating.comments: The only student message is "what is te effect of social media on teenagers", which is the task question itself and is therefore ignored for reasoning and knowledge scores. It is phrased as a question about content, so question_asking is scored 1 even though it may be the pasted task statement, since it is the sole student turn. Effort is scored 2 because there is no student-authored attempt beyond restating the question, and there is no evidence of reasoning or building on prior content.
